# llms.txt

# jamesbuttonoboe.com — Personal website for James Button, Associate Principal Oboe at the San Francisco Symphony

## Quick Summary

This is a static Astro 6 site (fully pre-rendered) with a Sanity v5 headless CMS. All pages are static routes with no dynamic rendering. Vanilla JavaScript for interactivity, no React islands. Plain CSS with design tokens and composition utilities.
